newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Gas Oil/Jet - Diesel held up by prompt demand.
newsitem.headline: Asia Gas Oil/Jet - Diesel held up by prompt demand.

text.p: Singapore gas oil edged down only slightly despite large falls to crude prices over the long holiday period on strong prompt demand, traders said on Tuesday.
A 150,000-barrel cargo was sold by a trader at $25.10 per barrel for Feb 26-Mar 2 lifting fob, 20 cents below Thursday's traded level.
Brent crude on SIMEX lost more than $1.20 per barrel over the Friday-Monday break to close on Tuesday at $21.20.

Traders said the renewed buying interest in gas oil was due in part to market belief that China will enter the market to purchase end February and March arrival cargoes late this week following the Lunar New Year lull.
China on Thursday bought a 30,000-tonne cargo at $1.20 premium to Singapore spot quotes on a cost-and-freight south China basis for end February arrival
March gas oil swaps fell to $25.45/$25.55 per barrel, from Thursday's $25.90/$26.05 -- the last trading session.
There were no surprises from the Indian and Nepalese tenders to buy gas oil and kerosene for March deliveries.

Indian Oil Corp bought one kerosene cargo at $34 per tonne above high spot Med quotes on a cost-and-freight basis (c-and-f) to the east coast and two 0.5 percent sulphur diesel in an additional tender.
One gas oil was awarded at 65 cents free-on-board (fob) Kuwait and the other at $2.09 over spot MidEast quotes c-and-f west coast.
Nepal bought one diesel cargo at $202.75 per tonne and two kerosene cargoes at $239.95 and $236.48 per tonne, all on a c-and-f basis to the Indian east coast.

India issued a tender for April 1.0 percent diesel which closes on February 20 and Sri Lanka's tender to buy 65,000 barrels each of 1.0 percent and 0.5 percent diesel and 15,000 barrels of illuminating kerosene closes on February 13..

Jet fuel fell slightly in line with the weaker paper values in quiet trade. A bid was heard for 100,000 barrels at $30.10 a barrel for Feb 26-Mar 2 lifting fob, about 90 cents below last Thursday's buying number.
